motions.description: Approve the consent agenda items including minutes, finance committee minutes, bills and vouchers, license applications, ordinances, and resolutions.
Approve a raffle application submitted by James Caporusso, Leyden Township Community Foundation Director, for their Wild Game Dinner fundraiser at Elmcrest Banquets on January 20, 2025.
Approve a raffle application submitted by Katie Muellner, Grand Chamber by O'Hare President, for their Installation Dinner fundraiser at Elmcrest Banquets on January 31, 2025.
